entries.title: Your Secrets stay with each copy of your first mate
entries.body: A computer that keeps a copy of your first mate can now keep your Secrets too. In its Ready to take over list, Keep Secrets there asks you to confirm once on that computer itself; after that your Secrets reach it sealed with its own lock, and each change follows. If your first mate starts there from its copy, Secrets work with no restore by hand. A computer you never confirmed on holds nothing it can open. The same list names each subscription or host that computer still needs its own sign-in for, with a button that starts it from this window.

picture.alt: Settings, Devices, with Mac mini's Ready to take over list open and reading that Mac mini keeps your Secrets, sealed with its own lock
